li.span: coreState - holds general state of the program (IDLE, SEND)
displayState - holds state of the display, represents what is shown currently (SHOW_USB_MORSE, SHOW_UART_MORSE, SHOW_USB_TRANSLATION, SHOW_UART_TRANSLATION)
uartState - holds current uart connection state (UART_CONNECTED, UART_DISCONNECTED) - UART_CONNECTED by default, switching functionality currently not implemented
usbState - holds current usb connection state (USB_CONNECTED, USB_DISCONNECTED) - USB_CONNECTED by default, switching functionality currently not implemented

div.span: IDLE - default state, device receives and displays messages & translations, can switch between display modes; Symbol generation is not active
SEND - symbol generation is active; device can receive and display messages, can't switch between display modes

blockquote.span:
Display has 4 states (titles self-explanatory); pressing btn2 switches between modes while in IDLE state in the order displayed below
Translation modes don't update live (when new morse symbols arrived), morse modes have live update
